claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br), Tibbetts, Liverpool May 31, and
Queenstown 1st inst, with mdse and 505 passengers, to John
G Dale. May 31, off Mine Head, passed steamship Kanga-
roo, bound up the Channel; 3d inst, lat 50 13, lon 25, steam-
ship City of New York, hence for Liverpool; same day, lat
49 27, lon 27 03, steamships Ericsson, Bavaria, and a Glasgow
steamer, bound E; 4th, lat 48 35, lon 32, ship Vistula, bound
E; 5th, lat 47, lon 37, bark Atlantic (Br), bound E; 7th, lat 43[?]
52, lon 47 21, steamship City of Boston, hence for Liverpool;
10th, 290 miles east of Sandy Hook, steamships Fulton, and
City of London, bound E.
